short: Light Emission in Metal-Semiconductor Tunnel Junctions: Dire
title: Light Emission in Metal-Semiconductor Tunnel Junctions: Direct Evidence for Electron Heating by Plasmon Decay

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Mechanism of above-threshold light emission (photons with hbar*omega > eV) in electrically driven plasmonic tunnel junctions is unresolved. Plasmon decay heats the metal electron bath to a hot Fermi-Dirac distribution whose tail tunnels inelastically to emit above eV.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/gap), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/architecture), n18 (DES/variable_sweep), n5 (DES/method), n6 (PRC/deposition), n7 (PRC/forming). Premises: Si has an indirect gap, so radiative electron-hole recombination in the Si drain is strongly inhibited; Dividing by the high-voltage spectrum leaves f = 1/(1+exp[(hbar*omega - epsilon)/k_B T_e]) with epsilon = V + Delta - phi_s; semiconductor side approximated by a step

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Patterned Au bars are isolated rods (about 5:1 aspect) in a regular periodic array, with rough grainy edges

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The bar-array device carries a localized plasmon resonance peaked near 2.0 eV that forms the high-voltage emission envelope. Plasmon-electron interactions excite electrons above E_F, which thermalize into a Fermi-Dirac bath at T_e above the lattice temperature.
states.detail: Absorbed: n10 (PRP/value), n13 (MEC/pathway), n14 (PRP/descriptor), n19 (PRP/value), n17 (PRP/descriptor). Premises: Voltage-driven blueshift of the high-energy cutoff is a known footprint of electrically driven plasmon emission (refs 20, 21); Energy quantum given to the electron bath per plasmon decay scales with plasmon energy, so k_B T_e is proportional to hbar*omega_max

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Biased at 1.6-2.2 V the junction emits light with a substantial part of its spectrum above the applied-voltage energy eV

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Above-threshold light emission in Au/Al2O3/p-Si tunnel junctions results from heating of the metal electron bath by plasmon decay
